{"findings":[{"location":"lyrics (verse 5)","severity":"major","source_quote":""When in the slippery paths of youth
With heedless steps I ran,
Thine arm unseen conveyed me safe,
And led me up to man."","suggested_fix":"Translate the final line to convey 'led me up to man' as 'førte meg fram til modenhet' or 'førte meg frem til voksenlivet'. Preserve the sense of being led to adulthood.","translation_quote":""Da jeg på ungdommens glatte sti
Med tankeløse skritt fór fram,
Din usette arm bar meg i sikkerhet,
Og førte meg til mannens ham.""},{"location":"lyrics (verse 7)","severity":"major","source_quote":""O how shall words with equal warmth
The gratitude declare,
That glows within my ravished heart?
But thou canst read it there."","suggested_fix":"The English 'ravished heart' means a heart enraptured or filled with delight. Replace the incorrect 'forrykte hjerte' (which means deranged/crazy) with a correct Norwegian rendering such as 'mit henrykte hjerte', 'mitt henrykte hjerte', or 'mitt oppglødde hjerte' to preserve the positive devotional sense.","translation_quote":""Å, hvordan skal ord med like varm glød
Uttrykke takknemligheten klar,
Som brenner i mitt forrykte hjerte?
Men du kan lese det der.""},{"location":"lyrics (verse 10)","severity":"major","source_quote":""When worn with sickness, oft hast Thou
With health renewed my face;
And, when in sins and sorrows sunk,
Revived my soul with grace."","suggested_fix":"Verse contains several translation errors and an untranslated English word. Line 1 should convey 'When worn with sickness, oft hast Thou / With health renewed my face' — e.g. 'Når jeg, tynget av sykdom, ofte, har Du med helbred fornyet mitt ansikt.' The translator must also render 'Revived my soul with grace' into Norwegian (e.g. 'og, når jeg, sunket i synd og sorg, Du gjenopplivet min sjel med nåde'). Remove the stray English 'Revived' and the unclear word 'røye'.","translation_quote":""Når tære av sykdom ofte deg
Med nytt helbred har kledt mitt øie;
Og når i synder og sorg sunket ned,
Revived min sjel ved nådens røye.""},{"location":"paragraph about hymn title (second paragraph)","severity":"minor","source_quote":""When All Thy Mercies O My God,"","suggested_fix":"Either translate the parenthetical 'original title' fully into Norwegian or mark the original English title clearly as the original title. If you keep the English title, present it as a quoted original title (e.g. originaltittel: «When All Thy Mercies O My God») but consider translating the in-text rendered title to Norwegian and treating the English as the original in italics or quotes. This is a minor consistency issue rather than a fidelity error.","translation_quote":""Salmen «Når alle dine miskunner, min Gud» (originaltittel: "When All Thy Mercies O My God"),"}],"passed":false,"score":78}
